Daily breakthroughs (official/release-first)
• Probabilistic weather ensembles and deterministic AC-OPF constraints are jointly enforced for dispatch safety.
• NERC-CIP ESP/DMZ segmentation is treated as a hard control boundary for all cloud advisory flows.
• OpenADR-style fan-out dispatch scales with bounded latency under 500k DER endpoint simulations.
Forecast and physics control plane
Weather/PMU streams feed forecast ensembles and dispatch planners.
AC-OPF gate verifies thermal/voltage/frequency feasibility before setpoint release.
dispatch p95: 788ms · opf gate p95: 154ms
Compliance and dispatch outcomes
AC-OPF violation block rate: 100.0%
OpenADR dispatch SLA rate: 94.4%
Renewable curtailment reduction: 52.1%
Per-DER monthly TCO reduction: 26.4%
NERC-CIP hard boundary rule
Cloud agents provide advisory decisions only; BES control actions remain within controlled ESP/DMZ lanes.
No direct agent-originated write paths cross high-impact BES control boundaries.
